name: Pantera Lithium Limited
summary: Pantera Minerals Limited, established in 2020 and based in West Perth, explores for and develops mineral resources in Australia, mainly iron ore, copper, manganese and polymetallic minerals. It holds 80% of the Yampi iron ore project, about 640 square kilometers with one granted license and four applications, and owns another project of 17 square kilometers in the Buccaneer Archipelago of the Kimberley Region.
